meanings.note: Jeudi, alors. Invariable French adverb meaning 'then'; placed immediately after the conjugated verb in simple tenses.

meanings.note: à + le contracted: au boulot, au téléphone

examples.trans: I've got a problem at work.

meanings.note: Time: avant mon départ. Core French preposition meaning 'before', linking a noun phrase or infinitive complement to the clause.

meanings.note: Core French preposition meaning 'with', linking a noun phrase or infinitive complement to the clause.
